title: Spike-01A Windows Basic Metrics Probe
scope: Current development machine result only; not generalizable to other hardware.

permission_tests.reason: Not executed; no UAC elevation was triggered.

comparison.note: The v3 and v4 runs enumerated different process populations (346 versus 308) and had different limited-access populations (153 versus 130). The 127-to-130 CPU-time and I/O differences are observed cross-run deltas only; they cannot establish causal improvement. The within-run v4 evidence is that all 130 processes with a successfully opened PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION handle also produced readable CPU time, working set, private memory, and I/O results. Resource differences are observed on this machine only and are not a cross-hardware estimate.

privacy.process_detail_retention: in memory only; aggregate counts only in report

notes.process_detail_permission_denied_count: Number of processes with at least one denied child read; not a sum of denied API calls.
notes.process_detail_handle_access: On supported Windows 10/11, CPU time, working set, private memory, and I/O use PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION with one shared process handle per detail pass.
notes.uptime_latency: system.uptime_ms call latency is measured around the direct GetTickCount64 call.
